extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvalue Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Fundamental equation relating a matrix, its eigenvector, and eigenvalue.

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvalues
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Roots of the characteristic polynomial det(A - λI) = 0 representing scaling factors.

extracted_concepts.name: Characteristic Polynomial
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Polynomial obtained by taking the determinant of (A - λI).

extracted_concepts.name: Eigenvectors
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Nonzero vectors in the null space of (A - λI) that scale under transformation.

extracted_concepts.name: Null Space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set of vectors that map to zero when multiplied by a matrix.

extracted_concepts.name: Diagonalization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Decomposition of a matrix into SΛS⁻¹ form using eigenvectors and eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Independence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Condition where n eigenvectors are required for diagonalizability.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix Powers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Computing high powers of a matrix efficiently via diagonalization.

extracted_concepts.name: Differential Equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Systems solved using eigenvalues to describe continuous dynamics.

extracted_concepts.name: Markov Chains
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Stochastic processes modeled using transition matrices and steady-state eigenvectors.

extracted_concepts.name: PageRank
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Google's algorithm for ranking web pages based on link structure eigenvectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Principal Component Analysis
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Dimensionality reduction technique relying on covariance matrix eigenvectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Symmetric Matrices
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrices equal to their transpose, guaranteeing real eigenvalues and orthogonal eigenvectors.

extracted_concepts.name: Real Eigenvalues
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Eigenvalues that are purely real numbers, guaranteed for symmetric matrices.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthogonal Eigenvectors
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Eigenvectors that are perpendicular to each other, forming an orthogonal basis.

extracted_concepts.name: Spectral Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: States that real symmetric matrices can be decomposed as A = QΛQ^T.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear Transformations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Geometric operations whose essential scaling behavior is captured by eigenvalues.

extracted_concepts.name: Identity Matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix used in characteristic equation det(A - λI) = 0.

extracted_concepts.name: Orthogonal Matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix with orthonormal columns used in spectral decomposition.

extracted_concepts.name: Diagonal Matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrix containing eigenvalues on its main diagonal.
